entries.body: The build is ready to review. The complete report includes the results, the changed files, and the details needed to review the work before it is shared.

entry_intent: Open notifications from the taskbar through the admitted host binding.
supported_actions: Set Do not disturb for this session
Set critical interruption consent for this session
expected_observations: Current snapshots supply history and action identity.
A focused action that expires remains focus-only and unavailable.
Refresh reads current state and does not repeat a mutation.
The elected announcement owner admits fresh arrivals and consent-gated interruption.
Unknown action outcome remains unconfirmed and is not retried.
note: Illustrative facts are injected through the real protocol with host-generated identities; this file does not define Elm policy.
expiry_sequence: Publish the Calendar entry live with Open, preserving service and incarnation identity.
Focus Open through the production renderer and report focus through the controller.
Publish the same entry as expired with no actions.
Verify the same DOM control retains actual focus, aria-disabled=true, data-focus-only=true, and emits no notification action on Enter or Space.
Verify exactly one elected announcement owner and no additional gallery live region.
